title: fix(docs): the root README's three phantom imports, and the ledger reading they froze (objectui#7417)
body:
Fixes #7417

The root README taught three names that no built `dist/index.d.ts` exports. Per the
ruling on the card, this PR pays down **those three TS2305s only** — it does not try
to make the whole README compile, and it deletes no example block and re-fences
nothing as `json`.

## The three, re-verified against today's built artifacts (not copied from the ledger)

| name | measured on `origin/main` at `900f8d99` | what it became |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectRenderer` from `@object-ui/app-shell` | `grep Renderer packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts` returns **nothing** — the phantom #7095 recorded in `examples/byo-backend-console/README.md` | `ObjectView` from `@object-ui/plugin-view` |
| `registerDefaultRenderers` from `@object-ui/components` | **0 occurrences** in that package's `dist/index.d.ts`; the only `register*` on it is `registerPlaceholders` | a side-effect import of the package |
| `createObjectStackAdapter` from `@object-ui/core` | **0 occurrences** in `packages/core/dist/index.d.ts`; present in `packages/data-objectstack/dist/index.d.ts`'s export list | the specifier moves to `@object-ui/data-objectstack` |

**No public surface moved. Clause-2 stays `no`** — every replacement is a spelling
that already exists in this tree:

1. **`ObjectView` from `@object-ui/plugin-view`**, with the `schema` / `dataSource`
   props that `examples/byo-backend-console/src/App.tsx` — the *running* source of
   the very example this section describes — already passes. The data source is read
   out of the `DataSourceProvider` the block installs one line above, via
   `useDataSource()` from `@object-ui/providers` (a real export of that package), so
   the block gains no new undefined ambient name.
2. **`@object-ui/components` registers its renderers as an import side effect** —
   `sideEffects: true` in its manifest, `import './renderers'` in its barrel under
   the comment `Register all ObjectUI renderers (side-effects)`, and 114 `register(`
   calls in the built `dist/index.js`. There is no registration function to call, so
   the block imports the package for the side effect and says so.
3. **`createObjectStackAdapter` ships from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`**, exactly
   as `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` already writes it — same factory, same
   config object, byte for byte. Core's omission is deliberate and documented:
   `packages/core/src/adapters/index.ts:9` is a **commented-out** export sitting
   beside `packages/core/src/adapters/README.md:8`, which says the adapters "ship as
   their own package". The `npm install` line above the block moves with the
   specifier, as does the one above the Minimal Integration block.

## The ledger moves in the same commit

`UNGATED_DOCS['README.md']` in `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` is shrunk to the
new reading: **9 diagnostics to 6**, the TS2305 paragraph gone. The entry itself
**stays** — the other six diagnostics are still there. Leaving the old text would
have frozen a measurement the tree no longer produces.

Its comment now also records the gap this card cannot close: `check-readme-exports.mjs`
states its surface as `packages/NAME/README.md`, and its census confirms it —
`0 outside any package`. The root README imports from several packages rather than
owning one, so that gate's rule has to be restated before its surface can move. Until
then **nothing gates this page's import names**, and a fourth phantom can arrive.

## Evidence

The gate is ledger-exempt on this page, so **green is the state both before and
after** and proves nothing. The reading that matters is the diagnostic list, taken
with the gate's own `analyze()` / `compileSnippets()` with `README.md` lifted out of
the ungated set, over the gate's own build closure
(`pnpm exec turbo run build $(node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs --build-filter) --concurrency=2`,
34/34 tasks successful).

**Before** — 9 diagnostics across 4 blocks:

```
[semantic]  README.md:100:20  TS2305: Module '"@object-ui/app-shell"' has no exported member 'ObjectRenderer'.
[semantic]  README.md:106:39  TS2552: Cannot find name 'myAPI'. Did you mean 'Map'?
[semantic]  README.md:107:29  TS2304: Cannot find name 'MySidebar'.
[semantic]  README.md:209:10  TS2305: Module '"@object-ui/components"' has no exported member 'registerDefaultRenderers'.
[semantic]  README.md:376:10  TS2305: Module '"@object-ui/core"' has no exported member 'createObjectStackAdapter'.
[semantic]  README.md:384:2   TS2304: Cannot find name 'SchemaRenderer'.
[semantic]  README.md:384:25  TS2304: Cannot find name 'schema'.
[semantic]  README.md:394:7   TS2420: Class 'MyCustomDataSource' incorrectly implements interface DataSource: missing findOne, create, update, delete, getObjectSchema
[semantic]  README.md:395:55  TS2355: A function whose declared type is neither 'undefined', 'void', nor 'any' must return a value.
```

**After**, at `ef7e191b3` — 6 diagnostics across 3 blocks, each one matching the
ledger's new prose one-for-one (4 undefined-name, 2 elided-body), and no TS2305 left:

```
[semantic]  README.md:107:39  TS2552: Cannot find name 'myAPI'. Did you mean 'Map'?
[semantic]  README.md:108:29  TS2304: Cannot find name 'MySidebar'.
[semantic]  README.md:391:2   TS2304: Cannot find name 'SchemaRenderer'.
[semantic]  README.md:391:25  TS2304: Cannot find name 'schema'.
[semantic]  README.md:401:7   TS2420: Class 'MyCustomDataSource' incorrectly implements interface DataSource: missing findOne, create, update, delete, getObjectSchema
[semantic]  README.md:402:55  TS2355: A function whose declared type is neither 'undefined', 'void', nor 'any' must return a value.
```

The Basic Usage block, which held one of the three, now has **zero** diagnostics.

### Gates, all run at `ef7e191b3` with the exit code captured before any pipe

| gate | exit | note |
|---|---|---|
| `check:doc-snippets` | 0 | `Semantic phase: 456 of 456 block(s) judged, 0 failed.` |
| `check:doc-types` | 0 | the component-type half of #7115's surface |
| `check:doc-fences` | 0 | |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 | plus a direct control-byte scan of both changed files: no hits |
| `check:readme-exports` | 0 | `421 self-imports judged (421 real, 0 wrong-path, 0 fabricated)` |
| `lint:root` | 0 | the only lint population this diff intersects: `0 errors`, 33 pre-existing warnings, none in either changed file |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | verbatim: `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |

**The gate's own test suites**, since this diff edits a gate script — all five suites
in `scripts/__tests__` that name it: `Test Files 5 passed (5) · Tests 319 passed (319)`.
One of them, `check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`'s
*"is DECLARED debt rather than absent, and its reason names the card that carries it"*,
failed on the first attempt because the rewrite had moved the card number out of the
ledger **string** and into its comment; the string now names #7417 again, as the pin
requires, and says what it paid down.

`check:readme-exports` first exited 1 with three `@object-ui/plugin-ai` lines reading
`its type entry ./dist/index.d.ts is not on disk — run pnpm build first`. That is an
**unmet prerequisite, not a result**: `plugin-ai` is outside the doc-snippet gate's
scoped build closure by design. Building `--filter=@object-ui/plugin-ai...` turned it
into the real green above.

### Not run, stated plainly

The full `pnpm lint` / `turbo run lint` fan-out over all 40 packages, and any package
test suite: this diff touches one Markdown page and one `scripts/` file, and
`lint:root` — which is defined precisely as everything **outside** `packages/*`,
`examples/*`, `apps/*` and `docs/*` — is the complete lint population it intersects.
`eslint.config.js` declares no `project` / `projectService`, so no rule reads across
files and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. ESLint reports
`README.md` as `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied` — that
population boundary is read from the config, not assumed. CI runs the whole farm
regardless.

## Note for the parallel seat on `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`

This PR touches **only** the `UNGATED_DOCS['README.md']` entry and its comment
(lines ~633-663). It does not go near the `declared`-fragment verification logic that
#7505 is changing.

## One thing #7095 should know before it lands

#7095 proposes its fix as *"The real export is `ObjectView` ... It takes `objectName`,
so the fix is a rename in place."* Measured today, **that would compile and still be
wrong**: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `ObjectView` takes no `objectName` prop — it reads
`objectName` from `useParams()` and requires an `objects` metadata array plus a
`dataSource` — and its whole props surface is typed `any` (#7483), so a bare rename
raises nothing at build time and fails at runtime. The spelling used here is
`@object-ui/plugin-view`'s `ObjectView`, which has a real typed props surface and is
what the working example runs. Left as a comment on #7095 as well.
